- [LSCO.4.7.12] **The author-facing test surface**, `.dstest` ([LTSL.2]) — a
  separate file type rather than a capability. The imperative-shaped surface
  the language has — activation-scoped facts and per-fact supersedure on
  `after as <expr>` — sits in the base language per [LSCP.3] and [LRST.2.2].
